$schema: Background image provenance. Each entry maps to RouteRecord.backgroundImage in shared/types.ts.
policy: Licensed or public-domain imagery only, committed locally with recorded provenance. No scraped or unlicensed assets (proposal.txt: Assumptions).
servingNote: Records reference /assets/<file> and /assets/experiences/<file>. Person A or D must serve data/assets at /assets, or copy it into apps/web/public/assets at build time.
attributionRequirement: The two CC BY images must show their attributionLine wherever the photo is displayed. The CC0 image does not require it.
